content.text: I've used 4 of 5 EQE measurements. Response peaks near Sb fraction 0.43, so I'm spending the last one next to that point.

input.rationale: Across 5 EQE measurements (Sb 0.285, 0.398, 0.430, 0.558, 0.687), index 8 (Sb 0.43) had the highest EQE at 0.0056%. A quadratic fit through the bracketing points puts the maximum at about 0.436, right at index 8. The neighbour at 0.398 dropped sharply to 0.0025%, so the peak is narrow and sits between the Cu2SbO5 and CuSb2O6 compositions.

rejected.reason: EQE 0.00345%, near CuSb2O6 stoichiometry but lower than index 8
Not measured because of the budget. EQE fell off from 0.43 toward 0.69, though an Sb-rich second maximum can't be excluded.

content.text:
I submitted **index 8 (Sb fraction 0.43)** as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.0056%, the highest of the five measurements I was allowed.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.285 | 0.00216 |
| 7 | 0.398 | 0.00253 |
| **8** | **0.430** | **0.00562** |
| 12 | 0.558 | 0.00336 |
| 16 | 0.687 | 0.00345 |

- **Where the peak sits:** a curve fitted through indices 3, 8 and 12 puts the maximum at about Sb 0.436, essentially at index 8. That makes indices 7 and 9 the only places a better value could plausibly be nearby. I measured index 7 and it dropped sharply, so the peak is narrow.
- **Not tested:**
  - **Sb-rich end:** nothing above Sb 0.69 was measured. EQE at 0.687 was slightly higher than at 0.558, so a second peak on that side can't be ruled out. The GP model's final suggestion was also to explore there (index 22).
  - **Index 9 (Sb 0.461):** I chose index 7 instead, so the right side of the peak is unchecked.
- **XRD:** none of the 5 XRD measurements were used, so no phases were identified. The known crystal phases in this system sit at Sb 0.333 (Cu₂SbO₅) and 0.667 (CuSb₂O₆), which puts index 8 between them. It is likely a mixture of phases, but that has not been checked.
